Subject: Activation MAP & canary schedule — AsterPoint post-signature next steps

Brian — congrats again on signing. Attached is an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and a short evaluation plan draft to embed in the MAP. This note outlines the proposed post-signature sequence so we can lock dates this week. High-level asks: can you confirm the canary timing window and training attendee list?

Key milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (Sep 24–26): Kickoff + environment access (VPC peering + test keys)
- Week 1 (Oct 1–4): Canary 1 (10% traffic; Redwood hosted variant) — 48 hrs observation
- Week 3 (Oct 15–19): Canary 2 (50% traffic; scale test) + performance validation
- Week 5 (Nov 1–3): Migration cutover window (staged shift)
- Week 6 (Nov 5–9): Post-cutover hypercare + training sessions for ops

Attachments: ASTERPOINT_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners/gates), ASTERPOINT_EvalPlan_v1.md (eval prompts + pass/fail criteria), ASTERPOINT_TrainingRoster.csv (initial attendee list placeholder).

If the dates above look off for your internal calendar we can shift the canary to the week of Oct 8.

Next step: please reply with: (1) confirmation of the canary week, (2) the engineer who will accept VPC peering requests, and (3) any compliance items that need the SOC2 evidence earlier.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short calendar invite and the updated MAP once I hear back.

— Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Brian Lowe <brian.lowe@asterpoint.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Sep 2029 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation MAP & canary schedule — AsterPoint post-signature next steps

Brian — great, thanks for the quick confirmation. Per your asks I've attached an updated MAP (ASTERPOINT_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short evaluation appendix here. Summary answers below so Emily has what she needs to onboard: 

- SOC2 package: sending a curated bundle via SharePoint link in this thread (see related_links). We will also provide a short checklist you can hand to procurement.

- Canary pass/fail (48-hr):
  - Latency: token-gen p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms (for our hosted baseline); we will provide per-route baselines in the MAP.
  - Error rate: production 5xx <= 0.2% sustained during the window; any spike >0.5% triggers rollback.
  - Quality regression: eval prompts (included in ASTERPOINT_EvalPlan_v1.md) — baseline acceptance rate >= 92% on the control prompt set.

- Proposed canary execution notes:
  - Canary 1 (Oct 1–4): route 10% of traffic to Redwood endpoint, continuous monitoring (metrics + sampled transcripts forwarded to your SRE).
  - Canary 2 (Oct 15–19): scale to 50% with performance tuning (batching/kv-cache profiles).
  - Migration cutover (Nov 1–3): staged shifting by route; database reads remain on same cluster, write path staged after validation.

- Training: we can deliver two 90-minute sessions during Nov 5–9. Ben will own ops training materials; Vanessa will run the canary war-room. Please send attendee names and time zone preferences by Mon Sep 23.

Action items I took from this thread and updated in the MAP:
- Emily Park — VPC peering owner (AsterPoint) — onboarding checklist item assigned
- Redwood: SOC2 bundle + procurement checklist (due Sep 25)
- MAP owner: Jordan Blake — coordinate canary runbook and monitoring hooks
- Ops trainer: Ben Carter — training decks and runbooks
- Canary lead (Redwood): Vanessa Ortiz — live war-room and rollback authority

Attachments: ASTERPOINT_MAP_v1.xlsx (owners column updated), ASTERPOINT_EvalPlan_v1.md (eval prompts + acceptance scripts).

Adding a couple of operational clarifications (keeping Brian & Emily in loop):

1) Canary observation windows — Redwood will collect metrics continuously but we'll call formal checkpoints at 4h, 24h, and 48h. At each checkpoint we assess the three domains: stability (5xx), latency (p95), and quality (eval pass rate).

2) War-room staffing — proposed rotation: Vanessa (lead), Ben (ops trainer / deck owner), Priyom (SLA and routing policy), Jordan (customer comms). Ben will circulate the training outline by Tue Sep 24.

3) Training logistics — prefer Nov 6 for SRE session and Nov 8 for Product Ops (both 11:00–12:30 PT). Brian / Emily — if those dates look ok, we will send calendar invites and a pre-read.

4) Quick note on attachments: please treat ASTERPOINT_EvalPlan_v1.md as the canonical prompt list for canary checks. If AsterPoint wants additions, flag them by Sep 23 so we can bake them into automated runs.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
